unit_description: Cybersecurity Professionals includes not only technically focused staff, but also those who apply knowledge of cybersecurity when preparing their organization to successfully implement its mission. A knowledgeable and skilled cybersecurity workforce is needed to address cybersecurity risks within an organization’s overall risk management process. Task include: a) conceptualizing, designing, procuring, and/or building secure information technology (IT) systems, with responsibility for aspects of system and/or network development; b) providing the support, administration, and maintenance necessary to ensure effective and efficient information technology (IT) system performance and security; c) providing leadership, management, direction, or development and advocacy so the organization may effectively conduct cybersecurity work; d) identifying, analyzing, and mitigates threats to internal information technology (IT) systems and/or networks; e) performing highly-specialized review and evaluation of incoming cybersecurity information to determine its usefulness for intelligence; f) providing specialized denial and deception operations and collection of cybersecurity information that may be used to develop intelligence; and g) investigating cybersecurity events or crimes related to information technology (IT) systems, networks, and digital evidence.

Animation and Visual Effects Professionals combine artistic and technical knowledge to conceptualize, plan, create, produce, develop digital content that display text, graphics, animation, imaging, audio and video, and other content type for animation, visual effects (vfx), new media and other linear digital media format. Task Include: a) conceptualizing the digital content with artistic and technical knowledge; b) planning and organize the workflow and production pipeline to ensure quality output; c) defining the content either visually, verbally or in written form regarding to the final output format; d) implementing or assisting in the implementation of that digital content; e) analysing and evaluating multiple options in decision-making process to make sure the most optimum solution is chosen; f) communicating clearly with the with supervisor and subordinates to ensure task deliveries are met in a timely manner; g) collaborating proactively with the other members of the team including from different expertise to solve problems; h) iterating creation of digital content to improve output quality; i) performing related tasks through digital content creation tools, rendering pipeline, tools and technology; and j) enhancing knowledge and coordinating work performance.

Digital Games and eSports Professionals combine artistic and technical knowledge to conceptualize, plan, create, produce, develop digital content that display text, graphics, animation, imaging, audio and video, and other content type for games, Virtual Reality (VR)/ Augmented Reality (AR) and other non-linear digital media format. Task Include: a) organising the creation of a game content, makes it happen on time and within the budget; b) creating the look, feel and story of a game, decides how the game will play; c) creating the artwork, such 2D, 3D, animation for visual art assets for the game; d) composing the music and creates the sound effects, integrates them into the game; e) implementing features and functionalities through the programming to make the game fun to play; f) testing the game to identify the mistakes in games, checks them for bugs, glitches and any errors; g) sollaborating proactively with the other members of the team including from different expertise to solve problems; h) optimising digital content for real-time performance efficiency; i) performing related tasks through digital content creation tools, game engines, tools and technology; and j) enhancing knowledge and coordinating work performance.

Creative Content Designers Professionals combine artistic and technical knowledge to conceptualize, plan, create, produce, develop digital content that display text, graphics, animation, imaging, audio and video, and other content type for various digital media including both linear and non-linear format. Task Include: a) creating world class, user centered designs through considerations of user research, business requirements, customer feedback and usability study findings; b) developing conceptual diagrams, wireframes, visual mockups, prototypes and visual design of web and mobile applications; c) developing and maintaining detailed user interface specifications; d) presenting design works to user experience, product, business owners for review and feedback; e) creating and implementing usability studies, personality, navigational structures, and affinity diagrams; f) providing usability recommendations based on industry best practices, analytics, and user behavior; g) collaborating proactively with the other members of the team including from different expertise to solve problems; h) optimising user experience based on the compilation of data analytics of user activities; i) performing related tasks through digital content creation tools, visualization software, tools and technology; and j) enhancing knowledge and coordinating work performance.
